upgrade_origin: accepted/applied migration prefix 1..7; sequences 1..7 are never renumbered or rewritten
legacy_row_policy: existing durable_jobs rows are preserved exactly except for the new nullable dedupe_sha256 column whose value is NULL for pre-sequence-8 rows
migration 8 never derives or backfills semantic dedupe identity from historical payload_json because packet-owned coalescing semantics may not be safely reconstructable by Foundation alone
a nonterminal legacy row with dedupe_sha256 NULL is never treated as proof of a semantic coalescing match; coordinator recovery remains fail-closed and packet-contract driven
new_job_policy: after migration 8 every newly enqueued durable job has non-null lowercase dedupe_sha256 computed by Foundation from the exact registered job_type, contract_version and caller-supplied packet semantic dedupe key
the caller-supplied dedupe key is bounded and ephemeral; raw dedupe material is not persisted in the Foundation schema unless it is independently required by the owning packet payload contract

before coalescing a hash match Foundation revalidates the persisted payload with the exact static packet contract and re-derives the semantic dedupe key; a SHA-256 collision or payload/key disagreement fails closed instead of returning the wrong job
uq_jobs_active_dedupe prevents more than one queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait row for one job_type + contract_version + dedupe_sha256
idx_jobs_dedupe_state supports bounded exact lookup for contract-specific coalescing states including a completed state when the owning packet explicitly requires completed-result coalescing
verification: durable_jobs.dedupe_sha256 is nullable only for legacy compatibility and rejects non-lowercase/non-64-hex non-null values
idx_jobs_dedupe_state has exact leading columns job_type, contract_version, dedupe_sha256, state
uq_jobs_active_dedupe is a unique partial index over job_type, contract_version, dedupe_sha256 for non-null dedupe values in queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait states
upgrade from exact accepted sequence 7 preserves every preexisting durable_jobs and job_attempts row
clean initialization and 1..7 upgrade reach the same exact release schema after sequence 8
